{{Quote|You're certain there is no child on Glee Anselm?''"<br />"''Into the shadow of the dark side, taken the child was. Shrouded is his fate from us.|Jedi Masters [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and Mace Windu, on Toa's kidnapping|<ref name="CotF" />|audio=NoChildOnGleeAnselm-CotF.flac}}
'''Zinn Toa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Youngling/Legends|infant]] born around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Toa resided on the Nautolan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] and was at some point discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. This information came to the attention of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which then entered Toa's identity into the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber crystal]], a device that contained a list of all known Force-sensitive younglings in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

During the Clone Wars, the Kyber crystal was [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stolen]] from the Order by the notorious [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] at the behest of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Sidious, who planned to use Force-sensitive infants to create an army of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]], directed Bane to kidnap four of the infants and deliver them to a [[Darth Sidious's secret facility/Legends|secret base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Bane [[Mission to Glee Anselm/Legends|abducted]] Toa, but [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], eventually discovered Sidious's plot and [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|rescued]] Toa from Mustafar. The young Nautolan was then taken into the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Among the children of the Jedi, there are no innocents.|Darth Sidious, plotting to kidnap Force-sensitive infants|<ref name="CotF" />}}
Zinn Toa was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]]<ref name="Drawing" /> born on [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] around the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CotF" /><ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> At some point, Toa was found to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], information which was eventually obtained by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The Order entered Zinn Toa's identity into the [[Memory crystal/Legends|memory device]] known as the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber crystal]], a database that contained the names of all known Force-sensitive infants in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CotF" /> The [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]&mdash;which was highly valuable, as it was used to recruit the future [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] of the Jedi Order&mdash;was protected by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] during the Clone Wars.<ref name="CoD">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref>

Despite the Order's attempts to keep the crystal safe, the crystal eventually came to the attention of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Sidious plotted to use the crystal to identify Force-sensitive children that he could use to create an army of [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] proficient in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] that would carry out his will throughout the galaxy. To this end, the Dark Lord hired the infamous [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|retrieve]] the Kyber crystal and use it to kidnap Sidious's future agents.<ref name="CotF" /> After [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|hunting down]] Master Ropal on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] him, Bane took the crystal and supplied Sidious with the information on it.<ref name="CoD" />

===Kidnapped===
{{Quote|The natural talent these children possess is too great to be wasted by the Jedi. I foresee an army of Force-talented spies in my service, trained in the dark side to peer into every corner of the galaxy from afar. And my enemies will be helpless against such vision. If the surgery fails, I will have lost nothing.|Darth Sidious, on his plan to brainwash Toa|<ref name="CotF" />}}
[[File:EscapeWithKids-CotF.jpg|thumb|left|323x323px|Toa and Wee Dunn in the arms of Darth Sidious's nanny droids]]
On the Dark Lord's orders, Bane set out to capture several Force-sensitive children and deliver them to Sidious's [[Darth Sidious's secret facility/Legends|secret installation]] on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Bane's first target was Toa, who was [[Mission to Glee Anselm/Legends|taken]] from Glee Anselm and delivered to Sidious's base, where he was tended to by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droids]]. Toa's kidnapping was seen in a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] to Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] during a [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] session by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to ascertain Bane's targets, but Windu received this vision only after the kidnapping had taken place.<ref name="CotF" />

Toa was soon joined by [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] infant that had also been [[Second mission to Rodia/Legends|captured]] by Bane. Together, the two were watched over by several nanny [[Droid/Legends|droids]], including [[RO-Z67/Legends|RO-Z67]], and the [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] form of Darth Sidious.<ref name="Cotf Ep. Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode203.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Children of the Force}}</ref> The Dark Lord planned to have the nannies perform a [[Conditioning procedure/Legends|conditioning procedure]] operation on the infants that would bind them to his will, despite RO-Z67's warning that the operation would likely kill Toa and Dunn. Before the droids could begin the operation, however, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], arrived at the base, having identified it as Bane's drop-off location, to [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|rescue]] the children.[[File:EscapingMustafar-CotF.png|thumb|right|309x309px|Toa and Wee Dunn in Ahsoka Tano's arms as they depart Mustafar]]As the holographic Sidious was alerted to the Jedi's presence, he ordered that Toa and Dunn be moved to a secondary facility and that the gravity supports for his base be turned off in order to destroy the evidence of his involvement in the kidnapping of the infants. The nanny droids complied and seized the children before the Jedi arrived. Hoping to avoid detection, the droids shut off the lights and hid in the shadows of the nursery room as Tano and Skywalker entered and inspected the room. Skywalker could still sense Toa's presence, but before he could continue searching, the droids attacked the Jedi, brandishing the infants as shields. As the nanny droids struggled with Skywalker and Tano, the base began to break apart and fall into the lava flow beneath it. The droid carrying Toa was quickly destroyed by Tano before falling into the lava, leaving the Nautolan safe in the Padawan's arms. Skywalker and Tano then rushed out of the crumbling facility and fled Mustafar with the infants in tow.<ref name="CotF" /> Neither Toa nor Dunn were returned to their parents, as the Jedi Order believed that the ultimate results of the traumatic ordeal that the infants had endured could not be determined. They were instead raised as Jedi from that point onward.<ref name="Children Ep Commentary" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zinn Toa first appeared in the third episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, entitled "[[Children of the Force]]." While the episode itself does not describe Toa's experiences following his rescue, both the "Children of the Force" episode commentary,<ref name="Children Ep Commentary" /> and the "Drawing Jedi Younglings" article on [[StarWars.com]] indicate that the young Nautolan was taken into the Jedi Order in the episode's aftermath.<ref name="Drawing" />
